event: The player sets the lantern down and draws the iron sword in the middle of the shop.
The player eyes the lit taper the lantern was lit from, standing on the counter.
The player cuts once, level, through the taper's middle.
The blade passes clean, and the burning top half drops onto the counter.
Its flame ducks and gutters low as it falls, then rights itself and burns on.
The shopkeeper has stepped back from the counter, staring at the two halves.
She looks from the burning half to the bare blade and asks the player what that was for.
